mount_rule: Every item rests (mount 'rest'): resting items are placed only on a support surface hit by downward rays against the evaluated home. Wall-attached or hanging items must set "mount": "wall"|"hanging" and "attach": {"surface": <name>, "surface_prefixes": [...], "direction_runtime": [dx,dy,dz], "max_gap_m": 0.02}; the attach ray must hit that surface or the item is refused. No item in this version is wall-mounted or hanging.
validation_basis: Positions/heights here are planning values. Placement re-verifies every item against the evaluated house.blend geometry (tools/reference_home_dressing.py place_on_evaluated_home); estimated boxes are never used to place.
